RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the July 21, 2003/Asadha 30, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Commerce and Industry; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Information and Broadcasting; Law and
Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Shipping; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Urban Development and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions—20
1
Funds provided to NGOs under
welfare schemes
*1. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a large number of complaints about the way
same NGOs got money under different kind
of welfare schemes which are not producing
good results; and
(b) if so, Government's response thereto
and the steps taken or proposed to be taken
in this regard?
Sex determination tests
*2. SHRI MANOJ BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to Government's
knowledge that despite the enactment of the
stringent laws banning the use of sex
determination tests including the use of pre-
conception technologies, there is open
advertisement occasionally in various
magazines inviting the eligible couples to
choose the sex of their unborn child;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to tackle such flagrant violation of legal
provisions?
Expansion of health care in Orissa
*3. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Orissa
Government has submitted a proposal of
Rs. 502 crores for expansion of health care;
(b) if so, the details of the project;
(c) whether the State Government has
also taken up the issue of establishment of a
super special hospital on the lines of All
India Institute of Medical Sciences,
New Delhi; and
(d) if so, the status of the project?
Commitment for free-to-air channels
*4. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given any
commitment to provide 70 free-to-air
channels in 72 rupees under the CAS
regime; and
(b) if so, the channels falling under this
category and the basis of this assessment?

2
WIN2\SESSION\1622RS 2
Trade agreement with China
*5. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of trade agreement between
India and China signed during the Prime
Minister's recent visit to China;
(b) the level of trade between the two
countries specifying the quantities and
values of the commodities exported to and
imported from China before the signing of
the agreement; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
by Government to achieve the targets now
set in the new agreement?
Export of mackerel shoals
*6. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to take
any action for exporting huge mackerel
shoals found off East-coast in the Bay of
Bengal; and
(b) the incentives proposed to be given
to the fishermen for this purpose?
Setting up of Fast Track Courts
*7. SHRI N.R. DASARI:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the progress
of implementation of the scheme for setting
up of Fast Track Courts (FTCs) launched
for speedy disposal of the cases has been
very slow;
(b) if so, when was the scheme launched
and the number of such courts set up so far,
State-wise; and
(c) the number of cases disposed off
through these courts?
Population stabilisation
*8. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Commission
on Population has suggested restrategising
the policies and programmes relating to
population stabilisation in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
New Rohini Residential Scheme
*9. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that DDA has
launched a new Rohini Residential Scheme;
(b) the reasons for launching such a
scheme when all the registrants for the
original 1982 Rohini Scheme have not been
allotted the residential plots, so far;
(c) the number of registrants who are
awaiting allotment of a plot in different
categories; and
(d) by when they are likely to get a plot?
Foreign technology collaborations
*10. SHRIMATI SHABANA AZMI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether in a bid to promote foreign
technology collaborations, the Centre has
liberalized the policy with regard to foreign
technology agreements further;
(b) if so, the main norms that have been
liberalized;

Restriction on import of dolomite as
building stone
3. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that restrictions on
import of dolomite as building stone have
been removed by Gazette Notification dated
June 27, 2001 issued by Director General
of foreign trade;
(b) if so, whether prescribed use of
dolomite was for the chemical industry and
steel plants but now it has been passed as
building material which has clearly been
established that it would be used as marble;
and
(c) if so, whether Government intends
to reconsider the decision taken by Director
General of Foreign Trade for allowing import
of dolomite when Rajasthan could fulfill
domestic requirement of dolomite as
building material?
Trade with countries of the common-
wealth of Independent States
1. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the steps Government have taken to
enhance India's trade with the countries of
the commonwealth of Independent States;
(b) whether it is a fact that a programme
was launched on 1st April, 2003;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have identified
any bilateral interest and investment; and
(e) if so, the details of the areas of mutual
interest?
Export of limestone from Rajasthan
2. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that limestone
export from Rajasthan has been on a gradual
decrease due to the decision by Government
to reduce import duty and hike rail and ocean
freight charges;

Review of Indo-Lankan free trade
agreement
4. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Sri Lanka have
decided to review the free trade agreement
between the two countries signed three years
ago;
(b) if so, the purpose of reviewing this
agreement;
(c) whether it has been reported that India
and Sri Lanka FTA could be a model for
similar agreements with not only countries
in the region but also elsewhere; and
(d) if so, to what extent this review would
help to increase the quantity of imports
allowed by both the countries?
Indo-China trade relations
5. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. M.N. DAS:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of issues for
improving trade relations between India and
China were discussed and many agreements
were signed;
(b) if so, whether all the hurdles between
India and China have been removed in this
regard;
(c) to what extent this would help in
improving the trade ties between the two
countries;
(d) whether a delegation of the
confederation of Indian Industry which
accompanied the Prime Minister had signed
a number of agreements with the Chinese
businessmen;
(e) if so, to what extent India has been
able to tap the Chinese market; and
(f) to what extent these agreements have
been helpful?
Indo-China trade
†6. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the trade
between India and China would reach 10
billion dollar in the next three years as a
result of the recent trade talks held with
China;
(b) if so, the assessment of the value of
imports as well as exports by India; and
(c) the average total value of foreign trade
during the last three years with China
indicating the value of imports and exports
separately?
Export of Indian goods
†7. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
such countries to which export of Indian
goods has started after March, 2000;
(b) if so, the names of such countries
together with the goods exported to these
countries; and
(c) the value of export during the year
2000-2001, 2001-2002 and 2002-2003; and
its percentage out of the total export?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
